title: 蒸汽火車頭工程
summary: 用熱力循環和非加壓機構模型理解鍋爐、汽缸、連桿、輪軌與維修。
summaryEn: Use thermodynamic concepts and unpressurized mechanism models to understand boiler, cylinder, rods, wheel-rail interaction and maintenance.
scope: 公開原理的分層工程教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務，並非原廠配方、施工圖或操作許可。
scopeEn: A layered course in public engineering principles. Steps are verifiable learning tasks, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, or operating authorization.

steps.title: 建立能量轉換圖
steps.objective: 完成「建立能量轉換圖」的概念模型與工程檢核。
steps.objectiveEn: Build and review the conceptual model for map energy conversion.

knowledge.title: 核心原理
knowledge.text: 燃料熱能經蒸汽與活塞轉為機械功，其中存在多種損失。
knowledge.textEn: Fuel heat becomes mechanical work through steam and pistons, with multiple losses.

knowledge.title: 總工程師檢核
knowledge.text: 畫出熱、功與排熱三種能量路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Draw heat, work and rejected-heat paths.

steps.check: 畫出熱、功與排熱三種能量路徑。
steps.checkEn: Draw heat, work and rejected-heat paths.

quiz.question: 哪個敘述最直接說明「建立能量轉換圖」的核心原理？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains map energy conversion?
options: 燃料熱能經蒸汽與活塞轉為機械功，其中存在多種損失。
壓力和溫度是不同狀態量，關係取決於工質狀態。
連桿運動可用手動模型展示，無需蒸汽或燃燒。
optionsEn: Fuel heat becomes mechanical work through steam and pistons, with multiple losses.
Pressure and temperature are distinct state variables related through fluid state.
Rod motion can be demonstrated by a hand-operated model without steam or combustion.
quiz.explanation: 燃料熱能經蒸汽與活塞轉為機械功，其中存在多種損失。
quiz.explanationEn: Fuel heat becomes mechanical work through steam and pistons, with multiple losses.
